Low.advice: Incorporate organic compost manure or grow nitrogen-fixing legume green cover crops.

Medium.advice: Maintain current organic matter levels. Standard maintenance dosing applies.

High.advice: Excess nitrogen promotes vegetative foliage at the cost of grain yield. Suspend nitrogen applications.

Low.advice: Apply near the root zone during sowing to improve early root establishment and seed development.

Medium.advice: Standard crop-specific maintenance application is sufficient.

High.advice: High phosphorus can tie up trace elements like Zinc and Iron, inducing micro-nutrient deficiencies.

Low.advice: Potassium deficiency reduces drought resistance and grain weight. Apply potash before flowering.

Medium.advice: Standard dose is sufficient for cell walls strengthening and pest resistance.

High.advice: High potassium levels are safe but unnecessary. Additional potash application will not increase yield.

Acidic.advice: Acidic soils bind phosphorus. Adding lime neutralizes acidity and raises pH to optimal ranges.

Neutral.advice: Ideal soil environment. High nutrient availability across all micro and macro plant elements.

Alkaline.advice: Alkaline soils tie up iron and zinc. Gypsum reduces soil alkalinity, improving micro-nutrient uptake.
